remaining_limitations: The highest-ranked neural architecture varies across the five TORGO seeds; no single-seed winner is treated as definitive.
Dual-Stream (Full) used 50 training-speaker-only pretraining epochs in addition to the matched 20-epoch supervised cap; total optimization steps therefore differ by the pretraining treatment.
TORGO pooled speaker ROC-AUC across seeds: 0.621 ± 0.087 (15 speakers per seed).
Five seed estimates reuse the same 15 TORGO speakers; seed SD measures run variation, while speaker bootstrap reflects subject sampling uncertainty.
The prespecified sensitivity-constrained TORGO threshold yields pooled speaker specificity 0.343 across seeds.
TORGO-only prespecified threshold policies yield held-out speaker specificity from 0.286 to 0.800; the external threshold was never adjusted.
Official UASpeech had already been evaluated in historical V7; this is a provenance-checked rerun of the same frozen model, not a new prospective external cohort.
Frozen official UASpeech speaker specificity at TORGO-locked thresholds: 0.200 across seeds; no external threshold adjustment was made.
Official five-seed estimates reuse the same 28 physical speakers; the cluster bootstrap resamples speakers jointly across seeds.
Matched M2–M8 channel diagnostics include 23 of 28 primary M3 speakers; channel curves use this common-content subset.
Official speaker ROC-AUC varies by seed from 0.333 to 0.877 (SD 0.193).
Undefined official speaker metrics from empty predicted or diagnosis classes are retained as missing values: {'Precision': 1, 'NPV': 4}.
Existing 0 dB TORGO noise Balanced Accuracy: 0.503 (seed 42 diagnostic).

Gender subgroup fold estimates use only folds containing both diagnoses; female: 8 valid folds, male: 14 valid folds. Diagnosis-specific groups have one class and no estimable ROC-AUC or fairness conclusion.
TORGO cross-microphone and noise diagnostics cover seeds [42] and [42], respectively; they are diagnostic rather than five-seed model-selection evidence.
Classical Random Forest TORGO speaker Brier worsened after temperature scaling (0.160 to 0.194); both variants are retained for audit.
Convergence replay: 0/25 completed outer folds hit 20 epochs; 24/25 fail the stability-and-replay criterion.
